target: Short shoot PO:0004701 (the small axillary tufts or fascicles of leaves) absent (PATO:0000462). The main leaves (leaf PO:0025034) are present, and the lower ones are spatulate and petiolate
fix: 'axillary tufts of leaves absent', 'axillary fascicles absent', 'leaves not fascicled' and 'without axillary leaf clusters' deny short shoots (PO:0004701) in the leaf axils. They are never 'leaf absent'.
reason: Cerastium has opposite leaves. Only the short leafy shoots in their axils are denied, and the blades are described.

target: The length 0.7-1.3 mm belongs to the involucral teeth (involucral bract PO:0009045, context 'teeth', the longer ones), not to the awns. 'Awns absent' (awn PO:0025349 absent) can stay
fix: 'with longer ones <n> mm' and 'the longer <n> mm' take the most recently named counted part (teeth, lobes, spines) as their bearer. When the awn was just denied in the same clause, never attach a following measurement to the awn.
reason: In Chorizanthe the involucral teeth are unequal and the awn is at their tip. A measurement after 'awns absent' cannot describe an awn.

target: Spines are absent only on the fruit (fruit PO:0009001, context 'fruit spineless'). The stem areoles have acicular spines. Cactus spines map to spine leaf PO:0025173, not thorn PO:0025172
fix: In Cactaceae, 'spineless' and 'spines absent' in the fruit, seedling or flower paragraph deny spines on that organ only. Keep the organ as the context. Cactus 'spines' map to spine leaf PO:0025173, never to thorn.
reason: Cylindropuntia prolifera has spiny stem joints and spineless, proliferating fruits.

target: Only the vegetative axillary branches of the stem are absent (axillary shoot system PO:0006343 absent). The 'branches' that are not twisted are inflorescence branches (higher order inflorescence axis PO:0009081). 'Not twisted' is a negated quality and must not be recorded as 'torsioned'
fix: 'axillary branches absent' in the stem or caudex paragraph maps to axillary shoot system PO:0006343. 'Branches' in the inflorescence paragraph maps to PO:0009081. Never merge the two into one 'branch'. 'not <quality>' must never be recorded as the positive quality.
reason: Dudleya has unbranched rosettes but branched cymes. The two statements are about different axes.

target: Only the basal (amphicarpic) spikelets are absent (spikelet PO:0009051, context 'basal'). The terminal spikelet is present and has an acute apex
fix: 'basal <part>s absent', 'proximal <part>s absent' and 'lateral <part>s absent' deny only the members in that position. Keep the position as the context and never record a taxon-wide absence.
reason: Eleocharis always has a terminal spikelet. Some species also have basal spikelets, and this one does not.

target: Only the caudex (the woody perennial stem base) is absent. Keep stem PO:0009047 with context 'caudex', or drop the statement. The aerial stems are present and tomentose
fix: 'caudex absent', 'without a caudex' and 'caudex lacking' deny the woody base only. Because 'caudex' is a synonym of stem PO:0009047, never record them as 'stem absent'. Record them with the 'caudex' context, or drop them.
reason: Every Eriogonum has stems. The flora says only that there is no persistent woody caudex.

target: Cauline leaf PO:0000013 absent (PATO:0000462). The basal leaves (rosette leaf PO:0000014) are present and evergreen
fix: 'cauline leaves absent' maps to cauline leaf PO:0000013, and 'basal leaves absent' maps to rosette leaf PO:0000014. A qualified leaf absence never falls back to leaf PO:0025034.
reason: The basal rosette leaves are described. Only the stem leaves are denied.

target: Only the hilar flap (a seed-coat outgrowth over the hilum PO:0020063) is absent. There is no PO class for it, so drop the absence. The seed (PO:0009010) is present and tuberculate
fix: In '<structure> over/on/at <part> absent', the absent thing is the head noun (flap, appendage, ridge), never the part named after the preposition or the organ of the paragraph. When the head noun has no class, drop the statement.
reason: The seed is described. Only a small flap on it is denied.

target: Anthers are absent only on the outer staminodes (staminode PO:0009077, context 'without anthers'). The anthers of the fertile stamens (anther PO:0009066) are present and straight after dehiscence
fix: 'without anthers', 'antherless' and 'lacking anthers' in a staminode or 'outer stamens' clause describe staminodes. Record staminode PO:0009077 and never a taxon-wide 'anther absent'.
reason: Mentzelia has petaloid outer staminodes without anthers and fertile inner stamens.

target: Bracts are absent only on the peduncle (bract PO:0009055, context 'peduncle', PO:0009053). The involucral bracts (PO:0009045) are present and have erect tips
fix: 'ebracteate' said of a peduncle, scape or pedicel denies bracts on that axis only. Keep the axis as the context. It never denies involucral bracts, floral bracts or bracts of the whole plant.
reason: Asteraceae always have phyllaries. 'Ebracteate' describes the stalk of the head.

target: Short shoot PO:0004701 (the axillary leaf fascicles) absent. The leaves are present. The 'loose, scarious to herbaceous sheath' is the connate leaf base (leaf sheath PO:0020104), not the leaf itself
fix: 'axillary leaves absent' and 'without axillary fascicles' (Caryophyllaceae) deny the secondary leaves of axillary short shoots, PO:0004701. Never record 'leaf absent'. A 'sheath' formed by the leaf bases takes its own qualities.
reason: Minuartia has opposite leaves joined at the base. Only the axillary leaf clusters are denied.

target: Bracts are absent only on the peduncle (bract PO:0009055, context 'peduncle', PO:0009053). The involucral bracts (PO:0009045) are present and have tufts of hair at their tips
fix: 'Peduncles ebracteate' and 'peduncles without bracteoles' deny bracts on the peduncle only. Keep 'peduncle' as the context and never record a bract absence for the whole plant or the involucre.
reason: Packera heads always have phyllaries. Only the stalk is without bracts.

target: Short trichomes (trichome PO:0000282, context 'short') absent on the leaflet (PO:0020049). The leaflet is present and greenish gray on the upper side
fix: '<qualifier> hairs absent' and 'without <qualifier> hairs' map to trichome PO:0000282 absent, with the qualifier and the organ of the paragraph as the context. They never deny the organ.
reason: Only one kind of hair is denied. The leaflets are described.

target: Phyllode leaf PO:0025335 absent (PATO:0000462). The pitcher leaves (leaf PO:0025034 / vascular leaf PO:0009025, 'pitcher') are present, and 'base cordate' belongs to them or their hood
fix: 'phyllodia absent' and 'phyllodes absent' map to phyllode leaf PO:0025335, never to leaf. In Sarracenia, phyllodia are flat non-pitcher leaves, and the pitchers stay present.
reason: Sarracenia jonesii has pitchers and no phyllodia.

target: Leaf lamina intramarginal vein PO:0025520 absent (the collecting vein along the margin). The leaf lamina (PO:0020039) is present and glabrous on the upper surface
fix: 'marginal vein absent', 'intramarginal vein absent' and 'without a submarginal vein' map to leaf lamina intramarginal vein PO:0025520 absent. They never map to leaf lamina, leaf or vascular bundle.
reason: This is the usual Sapotaceae venation character. The blade is described.

target: Bracts are absent only on the peduncle (sterile bracts, bract PO:0009055, context 'peduncle', PO:0009053). The floral bract (bract PO:0009055) is present and linear-lanceolate
fix: 'Peduncle ebracteate' (Orchidaceae) denies sterile bracts on the peduncle only. Keep 'peduncle' as the context, and the floral bracts stay present.
reason: The single flower has a floral bract. The stalk below it has none.

target: Petals are absent only in the inner whorl (petal PO:0009032, context 'inner'). The outer petals are present and fleshy
fix: 'inner petals absent', 'inner whorl absent' and 'outer petals absent' deny one whorl only. Keep the whorl as the context and never record a taxon-wide 'petal absent'.
reason: Annona reticulata has 3 fleshy outer petals. The inner petals are minute or absent.

target: The two statements are about different florets or spikelets. One lemma (lemma PO:0009037, lower floret or pedicelled spikelet) is awnless, and the upper lemma is awned (awn PO:0025349 present, context 'upper lemma')
fix: In Poaceae, 'awnless' and 'awned' within one taxon refer to different florets, lemmas or spikelets (lower/upper, sessile/pedicelled). Keep the floret or spikelet as the context. Never record both on a bare 'awn'.
reason: In Andropogoneae such as Apocopis the lower lemma is typically awnless and the upper lemma is awned.

target: Leaf lamina intramarginal vein PO:0025520 absent. The lateral veins (leaf lamina vein PO:0020138 or secondary leaf vein PO:0020140) are present and raised on both surfaces
fix: 'marginal vein absent' and 'without collecting vein' (Myrsinaceae/Primulaceae) map to leaf lamina intramarginal vein PO:0025520 absent. Never map 'vein' with a qualifier to vascular bundle PO:0005020 for a presence or absence.
reason: The veins are described. Only the vein along the margin is denied.

target: Whole plant PO:0000003 holomycotrophic (FLOPO:0991374, synonym 'achlorophyllous mycoheterotrophic'). Nothing is absent
fix: 'without chlorophyll', 'lacking chlorophyll', 'achlorophyllous' and 'chlorophyll-free' describe how the plant feeds. Map them to FLOPO:0991374 (or FLOPO:0991360 saprophytic when the flora says saprophytic). Never record them as the plant or any part absent.
reason: 'Without chlorophyll' was read as 'plant absent'. Burmannia wallichii is a mycoheterotroph.

target: The basal bladeless sheaths are scale leaves (scale leaf PO:0006003, cataphylls). No leaf lamina is absent. The leaf lamina (PO:0020039) of the foliage leaves is present and long-acuminate
fix: 'bladeless sheaths' and 'basal sheaths bladeless' (Cyperaceae, Poaceae) map to scale leaf PO:0006003. They never mean 'leaf lamina absent', because the foliage leaves of the same plant have blades.
reason: This is the same pattern as in the moss-flora check: the cataphylls lack blades and the leaves have them.

target: The inflorescence bract (bract PO:0009055) is present but not leaflike, without a distinct leafy blade. Nothing is absent. The glume statement is about another part and can stay
fix: 'without distinct (involucral) bract leaf', 'bracts not leaflike' and 'bract scalelike' (Carex) deny only the leafy blade of the bract. Record the bract with a scale-like or non-leaflike quality and never record 'bract absent'.
reason: The Carex spikes are subtended by bracts, but the bracts are reduced and scale-like.

target: The bracts (bract PO:0009055) are present and sheathless. Only a sheath on the bract is denied, and there is no class for it, so drop the absence. The lowest bract is longer than the inflorescence
fix: '<part>s without sheaths', 'sheathless' and 'not sheathing' deny a sheath on the part named. They never deny the part, and never map to leaf sheath PO:0020104 for a bract.
reason: In Carex, bracts are described as sheathing or sheathless. Here they are present and measured.

target: The fruit bract (bract PO:0009055) is present, and only its basal lobe is absent. There is no lobe class, so drop the absence or record 'not lobed at base'. The bract is present and dentate
fix: 'without basal lobe', 'without auricle' and 'without inner lobe' deny a sub-part of the organ of the paragraph, never the organ. When the sub-part has no class, drop the absence.
reason: In Carpinus, the presence of a lobe at the base of the nutlet bract is a character. The bract itself is described in detail.

target: Rosette leaf PO:0000014 (basal leaves) absent. The cauline leaves (cauline leaf PO:0000013) are present and alternate
fix: 'basal leaves absent' and 'radical leaves absent' map to rosette leaf PO:0000014. 'Cauline leaves ...' maps to cauline leaf PO:0000013. Neither falls back to leaf PO:0025034.
reason: Only the basal leaves are denied. The stem leaves are described.

target: Cauline leaf PO:0000013 absent (the stem or scape is leafless). The basal leaves (rosette leaf PO:0000014) are present and somewhat canescent beneath
fix: 'leafless' and 'aphyllous' said of a stem, scape or flowering stem deny the cauline leaves only. Map them to cauline leaf PO:0000013 absent and never to leaf absent when basal leaves are described.
reason: This Crepis has a rosette with a leafless scape. The rosette leaves are described.

target: Petals are absent only in female (pistillate) flowers (context 'female flower'). Male (staminate) flowers have petals with pubescent margins (petal PO:0009032, context 'male flower')
fix: In a paragraph headed 'female flowers' or 'pistillate flowers' (or 'male' / 'staminate'), every statement keeps the sex as its context. 'petals absent' there never becomes a taxon-wide petal absence.
reason: In Croton the petals are present in male flowers and usually absent in female flowers.

target: Leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 absent (PATO:0000462). 'Serrulate' belongs to the ligule (PO:0020105) or sheath margin, not to a stipule
fix: In Poaceae and bamboos, 'auricles' means leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106, and the ligule maps to PO:0020105. Neither ever maps to stipule.
reason: Grasses have no stipules. Both statements were sent to stipule, and the only thing absent is the auricles.

target: Leaf (PO:0025034) absent only on the lower part of the stem (PO:0009047). Keep 'lower part of stem' as the context. The upper leaves are present and have cuneate bases
fix: 'leafless in lower part', 'leafless below' and 'leafless above' describe where the leaves sit on the stem. Keep the position as the context and never record 'leaf absent'.
reason: The leaves are described. Only the lower stem is bare.

target: Lower glume PO:0006002 absent (PATO:0000462). The upper glume PO:0006004 is present and lanceolate
fix: 'lower glume absent' and 'first glume absent' map to lower glume PO:0006002, and 'upper glume' maps to PO:0006004. Neither falls back to glume PO:0009039.
reason: Digitaria often lacks the lower glume. The lanceolate glume is the upper one.
